title: EDC Infected Mushroom part 10 video by endari June 24, 2006
description:
This video is 17 of 25 files filmed at EDC by endari.  EDC is the Electric Daisy Carnival on June 24th, 2006 in San Bernardino from 4:00pm-4am.  This video has alot of video from the Infected Mushroom set.  Enjoy, and watch all 25 of my videos from EDC!  ENJOY!

-Endari aka Alex
